Klasse Client

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.client.clientLogic.Client
public class Client extends Object
Main client class for the GolfIt network client.

Manages the lifecycle of a GolfIt client session, including:

  • UDP socket communication with the server
  • Reliable message delivery via ChannelManager
  • CLI input processing via ClientCli
  • Keepalive via PingService
  • Dispatching incoming messages to the appropriate handlers

The client runs three concurrent components:

  • A scheduled ticker that drives the channel manager's retry logic every 100ms
  • An input thread that reads user commands from the console
  • A receive thread that listens for incoming UDP packets
